headline: Chiefs stop the Colts
what_happened: D.Jones ran with the ball on third down, which is the third of four chances to move forward, but J.Hicks stopped him after a short gain.
who: D.Jones ran while J.Hicks made the tackle for the Chiefs.
why_it_matters: This is great news for your boyfriend's team! The Colts are now further from scoring, which drops their chances of winning by 7 percentage points.
